title: Guardian of the Herd
description: A Samburu warrior, or moran, bears traditional scarifications alongside a Catholic rosary in Ngurunit, Kenya. Samburu warriors protect their livestock and serve as important partners in monitoring and protecting the region’s wildlife. A small number of the Samburu have also partly converted to Christianity while retaining many markers of their cultural identity.
translated_description: 在肯尼亚恩古鲁尼特，一位桑布鲁武士（或莫兰）身上既有传统的疤痕纹身，也佩戴着天主教念珠。桑布鲁武士守护着他们的牲畜，同时也是监测和保护该地区野生动物的重要伙伴。少数桑布鲁人也部分皈依了基督教，同时保留了许多自身文化身份的标记。
